messages.author: 5dd12f571ba3f242
messages.subject: Shiny-server problems with R 3.0.0
parts:
Hi there
I get the following message when I load a webpage in shiny-server

Error: package ‘shiny’ was built before R 3.0.0: please re-install it Ejecución interrumpida

But when I load the shiny package at R's console, it loads correctly. How can I get the newest version of shiny-server?
Thanks

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Shiny-server problems with R 3.0.0
parts:
Try this:

sudo su - -c "R -e \"install.packages('shiny', repos='http://cran.rstudio.com/')\""
